title: How Many Random Seeds? Statistical Power Analysis in Deep Reinforcement Learning Experiments
mechanism: Power analysis picks the number of seeds needed to detect a given effect with Welch t-test or bootstrap CI.
adaptation: Use our 5-seed SDs (val and OOF) to compute seeds needed for 0.01 crack IoU and 0.02 inactive IoU at power 0.8, for test-49 vs grouped CV.
min_experiment: Arm: power calculation on existing runs. Metric: seeds needed. Kill: >20 seeds on test-49 means stop using test-49 for decisions under 0.02.
evidence: R: tutorial with simulations on deep RL algorithms; Welch t-test and bootstrap CI power curves.
prior_overlap: partial: BRIEF already estimates 0.012 MDE for 5v5; formal power analysis across instruments not done.
